import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    "Person ID": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    "Gender": ["Male", "Male", "Male", "Male", "Male"],
    "Age": [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    "Occupation": ["Software Engineer", "Doctor", "Doctor", "Sales Representative", "Sales Representative"],
    "Sleep Duration": [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    "Quality of Sleep": [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    "Physical Activity Level": [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    "Stress Level": [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    "BMI Category": ["Overweight", "Normal", "Normal", "Obese", "Obese"],
    "Blood Pressure": [126, 125, 125, 140, 140],
    "Heart Rate": [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    "Daily Steps": [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    "Sleep Disorder": ["", "", "", "Sleep Apnea", "Sleep Apnea"]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Group by Occupation and calculate mean of each feature
grouped_df = df.groupby("Occupation").mean(numeric_only=True).reset_index()

# Create a bar plot for each feature
features = ["Sleep Duration", "Quality of Sleep", "Physical Activity Level", "Stress Level", "Blood Pressure", "Heart Rate", "Daily Steps"]
for feature in features:
    plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
    sns.barplot(x="Occupation", y=feature, data=grouped_df)
    plt.title(f"Mean {feature} by Occupation")
    plt.xlabel("Occupation")
    plt.ylabel(feature)
    plt.savefig(f"output_{feature}.png")
    plt.close()

# Create a heatmap for correlations
plt.figure(figsize=(10,8))
sns.heatmap(grouped_df[['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Blood Pressure', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']].corr(), annot=True, cmap="coolwarm", square=True)
plt.title("Correlation Heatmap")
plt.savefig("output_corr.png")
plt.close()

# Create a box plot for each feature
features = ["Sleep Duration", "Quality of Sleep", "Physical Activity Level", "Stress Level", "Blood Pressure", "Heart Rate", "Daily Steps"]
for feature in features:
    plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
    sns.boxplot(x="Occupation", y=feature, data=df)
    plt.title(f"Distribution of {feature} by Occupation")
    plt.xlabel("Occupation")
    plt.ylabel(feature)
    plt.savefig(f"output_dist_{feature}.png")
    plt.close()

# Create a count plot for Sleep Disorder
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x="Sleep Disorder", data=df)
plt.title("Count of Sleep Disorder")
plt.xlabel("Sleep Disorder")
plt.ylabel("Count")
plt.savefig("output_sleep_disorder.png")
plt.close()
